scope: Only native tokenizer canonical presegmentation/byte BPE; model/seed/options/driver/CFG/scheduler/lifecycle untouched

appleBase.copyright: Original Apple headers retained; original MIT LICENSE.md retained

changes: Use official CLIP regex pretokenization instead of whitespace-only word split.
Encode matched token UTF8 bytes with the official reversible byte alphabet before BPE.
Process BPE symbols as Unicode scalars and preserve reserved start/end tokens.
Read valid hash-prefixed merge rules and the final rule when a file has no terminal newline.
Match the canonical bounds guard in BPE merge update.
normalizationBoundary: Production CreationIntentDecoder emits normalized printable ASCII English. Exact CPU vectors additionally cover valid NFC Unicode with identity ftfy normalization. This is not a full ftfy mojibake/HTML-entity repair implementation and does not claim universal malformed-text parity.

tests.testCorpus: Selected merge closure245 rules/759 vocabulary entries, with original full-vocab IDs; full actual assets verified separately
